verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own docs describe a first-party MCP connection for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed). It uses OAuth 2.1 and exposes tools to list services, run SQL and read monitoring, which directly delivers the story. The evidence is a single summary line, though. Missing for 10: detailed setup documentation (endpoint URL, full tool reference) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) to your databases over MCP: OAuth 2.1, no API keys, tools to list services, run SQL, and read monitoring.
